title: Allele Variability Analysis Protocol
author: Sara Beier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkhqkt5w

steps.title: Remove Nextera adapters with Cutadapt
steps.instruction: Run Cutadapt v1.8.3 on each raw forward and reverse read file using the adapter sequence CTGTCTCTTATA. Example commands: `cutadapt -a CTGTCTCTTATA -o ca.file.forward.fastq.gz file.forward.fastq.gz` and `cutadapt -a CTGTCTCTTATA -o ca.file.reverse.fastq.gz file.reverse.fastq.gz`. Apply to all forward and reverse FASTQ files from the BATS and HOT datasets.

steps.title: Trim low‑quality bases with Sickle
steps.instruction: Execute Sickle v1.33 in paired‑end mode on the Cutadapt‑processed files. Command: `sickle pe -f /data/sara/LTG/pacific/BAT1/cutadapt/ca.file.forward.fastq.gz -r /data/sara/LTG/pacific/BAT1/cutadapt/ca.file.reverse.fastq.gz -t sanger -o /data/sara/LTG/pacific/BAT1/sickle/qtrim.file.forward.fastq -p /data/sara/LTG/pacific/BAT1/sickle/qtrim.file.reverse.fastq -s /data/sara/gesifus.strains/sickle/qtrim.file.unpaired.fastq -q 20 -l 50`. Run on BATS and HOT outputs from step 1 and on LMO raw data files.

steps.title: Interleave reads, remove rRNA, and separate protein reads
steps.instruction: Perform three actions with SortMeRNA v1.9:

substeps.instruction: Interleave forward and reverse trimmed reads: `merge-paired-reads.sh qtrim.file.forward.fastq qtrim.file.reverse.fastq file.inter.fastq`.

Remove rRNA using the personal reference database (personal_default_rRNA_DBs.fna, downloaded 2013): `sortmerna --I file.inter.fastq --paired-in -n 2 --db personal_default_rRNA_DBs.fna --other file.inter.protein -a 20`.
Unmerge the protein‑coding reads back into forward and reverse files: `unmerge-paired-reads.sh file.inter.protein.fastq file.forward.protein.fastq file.reverse.protein.fastq`.

steps.title: Convert reads to fasta, concatenate, and assemble with IDBA‑UD
steps.instruction: Execute three sequential commands using IDBA‑UD v1.1.3:

substeps.instruction: Convert interleaved paired reads to a merged FASTA file (filtering low‑quality reads): `fq2fa --merge --filter qtrim.file.1.fastq qtrim.file.2.fastq file.merged.fa`.
Concatenate all merged FASTA files from a time series: `cat file*.merged.fa > all.merged.fa`.

steps.title: Predict genes with Prodigal
steps.instruction: Run Prodigal v2.6.1 on the assembled contigs: `prodigal -i IDBA.contig.fa -a prod.pep -d prod.fas -o prod.gff -f gff`. Apply to BATS, HOT, and SOLA datasets using the contig file from step 4.

steps.title: Create BLAST database and run BLASTp against KEGG

substeps.instruction: Create a protein database from the KEGG reference FASTA (KEGG.faa, downloaded 15.05.2016): `makeblastdb -in KEGG.faa -parse_seqids -dbtype prot`.
Search predicted proteins against this database: `blastp -db KEGG.faa -query prod.pep -outfmt 6 -num_alignments 1 -num_threads 16 -out blastout.tab`.

steps.title: Create DIAMOND database and run DIAMOND blastp

substeps.instruction: Build the DIAMOND database from KEGG.faa: `diamond makedb --in KEGG.faa -d KEGG`.
Align predicted proteins with the DIAMOND database (more‑sensitive mode): `diamond blastp -d KEGG -q prod.pep --more-sensitive -k 1 -o diamond.tab -p 26`.

steps.title: Build Bowtie2 index and map reads

substeps.instruction: Create an indexed reference from the assembled contigs: `bowtie2-build contig.fa contigs`.
Map paired‑end reads (BATS, HOT, LMO, SOLA) to the index: `bowtie2 --very-sensitive-local --no-unal -x contigs -1 qtrim.file.forrward.fastq -2 qtrim.file.reverse.fastq -S file.sam`.
Map single‑end reads (MENDOTA) to the same index: `bowtie2 --very-sensitive-local --no-unal -x contigs -U qtrim.file.fastq -S file.sam`.

steps.title: Convert GFF to SAF and count features with featureCounts

substeps.instruction: Reformat Prodigal GFF for Subread: `convert_prodigal_GFF_to_subread_featureCount_SAF.pl -g prod.gff -s prod.saf`.
Count reads for paired‑end SAM files (LMO, SOLA, BATS, HOT): `featureCounts -p -a prod.saf -T 30 -F SAF -o feature.tab *sam`.
Count reads for single‑end SAM files (MENDOTA): `featureCounts -a prod.saf -T 12 -F SAF -o feature.tab *sam`.

steps.title: Predict subcellular locations with PSORTb and combine results

substeps.instruction: Run PSORTb with the three Gram‑type settings on each KEGG ortholog protein file (K*.prokaryotes.faa) and produce a terse tab‑delimited output: `psort -n/p/a K*.prokaryotes.faa -o terse | awk -F'\t' '{ $1="XXX" FS $1; }1' OFS='\t' | sed 1d > psort.K*.prok.tab`.
Concatenate all individual PSORTb result files: `cat psort.K* > psort.all.prok.tab`.

steps.title: Cluster proteins at 100 % identity with CD‑HIT
steps.instruction: Run CD‑HIT v4.6 on the predicted protein sequences: `cd-hit -i prod.pep -o out.clust -c 1.00 -n 5 -M 16000 -T 22`. Apply to BATS, HOT, LMO, MENDOTA, and SOLA datasets.
